evals.name: surfaces-a-system-contradiction
evals.setup: `initiatives/part-kit-tracking/srd.md` has `KIT-4` requiring each Part Kit to be picked 3 working days before its Stage Integration, and `KIT-7` requiring Part Kit lookups to be "fast" with no criterion. No `initiatives/part-kit-tracking/srd.review.md` exists. The corpus contradicts `KIT-4`: `docs/concepts/part-kits.md` states that part kits are picked 5 working days before stage integration. The server holds no draft gap for this SRD. The user answers the first question and then says "next".
